blocks.title: This onboarding link is no longer valid
blocks.subtitle: The link you opened has expired, is invalid, or the onboarding form has already been submitted. For your security, each link is single-use and time-limited.

blocks.title: Why am I seeing this?
blocks.body: Your onboarding access link may no longer work for one of these reasons: the link has passed its expiry date and time, the link or access key is invalid, or you have already completed and submitted your onboarding details. Once a form is submitted, the link can no longer be opened.

items.text: The link has expired. Onboarding links are valid for a limited time only.
The link or access key is invalid or was not copied completely from the email.
Your onboarding details have already been submitted, so the form is now closed.

blocks.title: Need a new link?
blocks.body: Please contact your HR / Onboarding Coordinator. They can re-send a fresh onboarding link to your registered email address so you can complete your details.

blocks.title: Contact HR to resolve this
blocks.subtitle: Reach out to the Onboarding team and they will help you get back on track.
